entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That Kaneshiro truly was an evil stain[n]on society.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Same with Kamoshida, and Madarame[n]too. They hurt and exploited others just[n]to satisfy their desires...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Still, there were people around them[n]who noticed their terrible deeds,[n]weren't there?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I wonder why they turned a blind eye...[n]Why doesn't anyone help?
They probably want to...
They can't.
They're too scared.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But they don't have the courage?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So it's because they don't have[n]the courage.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Humans are so weak.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Humans...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, do you think I'll really be able to[n]become a human?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: When I touched the Treasure... some[n]memories came back. I tried to force[n]myself to forget, but...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I really may not be human...
I'm sure you are.
Just be confident.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Talk about a lukewarm response.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Who do you think you're talking to?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Now that I think about it, I gotta be[n]human. I am the core of the Phantom[n]Thieves, after all!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Come on, it's not good for you to stay up[n]this late. Let's go to sleep.
I feel like my bond with[n]Morgana is growing deeper...
